shared_elements: head with headgear/hair element above the face
arms and hands articulated against the body
fine incised/linear surface patterning on skin or garment
justification: Both depict a three-dimensional human figure with a covered/adorned head, defined arms and hands, and dense fine linear patterning over the body surface, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is a blocky, schematic, compressed figure with a mask-like hatched face and folded limbs, while B is a naturalistically proportioned standing man with one arm raised holding an object, a sash and distinct headdress plume, so the poses, attributes and rendering conventions differ almost entirely.
